verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's own marketing describes custom monitoring policies with instant alerts and automated remediation of endpoint issues, which suggests event-triggered rules that fire actions. The evidence is only brief pricing and homepage blurbs, though, with no documentation of how users define rules, triggers or actions. Missing for 10: documented rule/trigger definition model, list of supported event types and actions, evidence that policies trigger scripts automatically rather than just alerting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
